instruction: Fix `clamp` in `numstats/number_theory.py` so values above the upper bound are clamped to `hi`. `clamp(10, 0, 5)` currently returns `10` instead of `5`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats/number_theory.py b/numstats/number_theory.py
--- a/numstats/number_theory.py
+++ b/numstats/number_theory.py
@@ -43,4 +43,4 @@
     """Return ``value`` clamped to the inclusive interval [lo, hi]."""
     if lo > hi:
         raise ValueError("lo must be <= hi")
-    return max(lo, value)
+    return max(lo, min(hi, value))
